message: The page language is not declared.
suggestion: Add a valid lang attribute to <html>.
Add meaningful alt text or alt="" when decorative.

message: Form control has no programmatic label.
suggestion: Associate a <label> using for/id or provide an accessible name.
Add visible text or an aria-label.

message: Heading level jumps from h1 to h3.
suggestion: Use sequential heading levels to communicate structure.

message: Positive tabindex changes the natural keyboard order.
suggestion: Use DOM order and tabindex="0" only when necessary.
Use a unique id for every element.
